title: Optional chaining through nested models
summary: Follow optional properties with ?. and transform a present value with Optional.map.
triggers: a value may be absent at several levels of a model
prompts: Display an uppercase city label even when a profile has no address.
invariant: Any missing link produces nil and the final fallback handles it.
mantra: Chain the path; map the value; supply a default.
pitfalls: Force unwrapping any link can crash.
Optional.map transforms one wrapped value; it does not iterate over a collection.
